June 8, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Riverpoint Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Pfizer Inc (PFE) by 9.02% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc bought 15,568 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.80% with the market. The institutional investor held 188,196 shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.68M, up from 172,628 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Pfizer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $214.30B market cap company. The stock increased 0.40% or $0.145 during the last trading session, reaching $36.635. About 7.33 million shares traded. Pfizer Inc. (NYSE:PFE) has risen 10.95% since June 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.62% the S&P500.
